script: (() => { const g = window.__ns.game; g.input.typed = 'TOOLUP'; g.simulate(0.5); const log = []; const keys = ['KeyW','KeyA','KeyS','KeyD','ShiftLeft']; for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { const k = [keys[i % 5], keys[(i * 3) % 5]]; g.cam.yaw += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5; if (i % 7 === 0) g.player.inventory.select(['pistol','smg','shotgun','rifle'][i % 4]); g.simulate(0.4, [...k, 'Mouse2', ...(i % 2 ? ['Mouse0'] : [])], i % 3 === 0 ? ['Mouse0'] : []); if (g.state !== 'play') { log.push('state ' + g.state + ' at ' + i); g.simulate(6); } } return { log, s: g.debugState() }; })()

(() => { const g = window.__ns.game; const log = []; for (let r = 0; r < 4; r++) { if (!g.player.vehicle) { const v = g.nearestCar(40) || g.spawnCarInFront('kestrel'); const d = v.doorPoint(1); g.player.pos.set(d.x, g.player.pos.y, d.z); g.simulate(0.1); g.simulate(2.5, [], ['KeyF']); } for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { const st = ['KeyA', 'KeyD', null][Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)]; g.simulate(0.5, ['KeyW', ...(st ? [st] : []), ...(i % 5 === 0 ? ['Space'] : [])]); } log.push(g.debugState()); g.simulate(1, ['KeyS']); g.simulate(0.2, [], ['KeyF']); g.simulate(1); } return log; })()

(() => { const g = window.__ns.game; g.police.addStars(4); const log = []; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { g.simulate(1, ['KeyW', 'ShiftLeft', 'Mouse2'], i % 2 ? ['Mouse0'] : []); g.cam.yaw += 0.3; if (g.state !== 'play') { log.push(g.state + '@' + i); g.simulate(7); } } return { log, s: g.debugState(), heli: !!g.police.heli, cruisers: g.police.cruisers.size }; })()
